name: Elizabeth
notes: Put your containers at the curb the night before, after 6:00 PM.

Wednesday is recycling day and alternates: Paper weeks take newspapers (tied or in brown paper bags), mixed office paper in a separate reusable container, and cardboard folded and tied or nested. Metal weeks take aluminum and tin cans, glass bottles and jars and plastic containers #1, #2 and #5, rinsed and mixed in one container. No plastic bags.

Bulk: up to three household items (couches, tables, chairs, mattresses, dressers, rugs) on your second garbage day, Thursday or Friday, never Monday or Tuesday. No doors, windows, TVs or construction material.
Metal and appliances, and leaves, grass, branches and brush, are picked up by appointment only: call 908-820-4150 before putting them out. Branches go in bundles of 4 feet and 75 lb at most.
TVs, monitors and computers go to the Recycling Center, 523 Trenton Ave (Mon-Fri 8 AM-6 PM, Sat and Sun to 4 PM). Two car tires may go out with Thursday or Friday garbage.
A pickup that falls on a holiday is picked up the next day.
Separating recyclables is the law, even with private service, and is enforced with summonses. Buildings with three or more units need an outside enclosure with garbage and recycling signs.
sources: 2026 Trash & Recycling Calendar (City of Elizabeth DPW, Recycling Division), checked 2026-11-19: https://www.elizabethnj.org/DocumentCenter/View/9644/City-of-Elizabeth-Recycling-2026-v6-1BLEEDS
